title: Invest in the questions worth answering
lead: Artifactory’s opportunity is a company-level conversation about sensing and photonic design tools.
description: The supplied work supports a focused discussion of technical direction and validation needs, not a current financial ask or traction claim.

sections.title: Why these projects belong together
paragraphs: ArtiSense supplies an intended sensing problem. AIFIELD explores tools that could accelerate design work. Their relationship is a development hypothesis, not proof of a shared commercial result.

sections.title: Evidence before projections
paragraphs: The available summaries cover optical research, chip design, simulation and limited agent assistance. Device accuracy, revenue, customers and commercial terms require separate confirmation.

sections.title: What an investor can assess now
paragraphs: Explore each project’s architecture, examples, limitations and proposed next experiments, then contact the company to request current materials and discuss investment.
